description.zh: 官方参考插件：逐项演示 v1 插件能做的每一件事——六个权限、闸门的 401/403/429、宿主握手、私有数据目录、崩溃重拉、嵌入界面与独立运行。
description.en: The official reference plugin: every v1 capability, one section each -- the six permissions, the gate's 401/403/429, the host handshake, the private data directory, crash restarts, the embedded page and standalone mode.
